shlokas.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् | छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ||1||
shlokas.meaning: The Blessed Lord said: There is an imperishable banyan tree with its roots above and branches below. Its leaves are the Vedic hymns. One who understands this tree knows the Vedas.
shlokas.guidance: Understand the world as temporary and rooted in a higher reality.

shlokas.sanskrit: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः | अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके ||2||
shlokas.meaning: Its branches spread upward and downward, nourished by the gunas, with sense objects as buds; its roots extend downward into the human world, binding actions.
shlokas.guidance: Recognize how desires and actions bind the soul.

shlokas.sanskrit: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा | अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूलमसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा ||3||
shlokas.meaning: Its form cannot be perceived here; neither its beginning nor its end is known. One must cut down this deeply rooted tree with the weapon of detachment.
shlokas.guidance: Practice detachment to free yourself from illusion.

shlokas.sanskrit: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यं यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः | तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी ||4||
shlokas.meaning: One should seek that supreme abode, having reached which one never returns. I surrender to that Primeval Person from whom all creation has evolved.
shlokas.guidance: Seek the ultimate spiritual goal beyond rebirth.

shlokas.sanskrit: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः | द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् ||5||
shlokas.meaning: Those free from pride and delusion, detached, devoted to the Self, freed from desires and dualities, attain that imperishable state.
shlokas.guidance: Inner purity and balance lead to liberation.

shlokas.sanskrit: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः | यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ||6||
shlokas.meaning: Neither the sun, moon, nor fire illumines that abode. Having reached it, one does not return. That is My supreme dwelling.
shlokas.guidance: The highest truth transcends physical light.

shlokas.sanskrit: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः | मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ||7||
shlokas.meaning: The living beings in this world are My eternal fragments, struggling with the six senses including the mind.

shlokas.sanskrit: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः | गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात् ||8||
shlokas.meaning: When the soul takes a body or leaves it, it carries the senses as the wind carries fragrance.
shlokas.guidance: The soul is continuous beyond physical change.

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च | अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते ||9||
shlokas.meaning: Presiding over the senses and mind, the soul experiences sense objects.

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम् | विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः ||10||
shlokas.meaning: The deluded do not perceive the soul’s journey, but the wise see with the eye of knowledge.

shlokas.sanskrit: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम् | यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः ||11||
shlokas.meaning: Striving yogis perceive the Self within, but the undisciplined do not.

shlokas.sanskrit: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम् | यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् ||12||
shlokas.meaning: The light of the sun, moon, and fire comes from Me.
shlokas.guidance: Recognize the divine source of all energy.

shlokas.sanskrit: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा | पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ||13||
shlokas.meaning: Entering the earth, I sustain beings and nourish plants as the moon.

shlokas.sanskrit: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः | प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ||14||
shlokas.meaning: As digestive fire, I digest food in all beings.

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च | वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम् ||15||
shlokas.meaning: I dwell in all hearts; from Me come memory and knowledge. I am known through the Vedas.

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च | क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते ||16||
shlokas.meaning: There are two beings: the perishable and the imperishable.

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः | यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः ||17||
shlokas.meaning: Beyond these is the Supreme Person who sustains all worlds.

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः | अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ||18||
shlokas.meaning: I transcend both perishable and imperishable; hence I am known as Purushottama.

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् | स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत ||19||
shlokas.meaning: One who knows Me thus worships Me with full devotion.
shlokas.guidance: Right understanding leads to complete devotion.

shlokas.sanskrit: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ | एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत ||20||
shlokas.meaning: This most secret teaching has been spoken. Knowing this, one becomes fulfilled.
